Before your clinic

Getting started

This handbook covers everything you do on-screen during a consultation: seeing who's waiting, recording symptoms and vitals, prescribing, ordering labs, and closing out the visit. Every screenshot is the real system.

  1. 1Open the hospital system in your browser and go to the address given to you by the Admin team.
  2. 2Type the Username and Password your Admin created for you.
  3. 3Click Login. You land on your Doctor Dashboard automatically.
🔒Forgot your password? Only an Admin can reset it — ask them directly.
👁 What you'll see — the login screen

Status colours at a glance

Your queue is split into two groups by these statuses.

Checked-in — arrived, waiting for you, ready to open
Confirmed — booked but not yet arrived, not clickable yet
Completed — moves to Patient Visit History
1

Your patient queue

Doctor Dashboard — everyone waiting to see you today, split into Checked-in and Confirmed.

  1. 1Only patients marked Checked-in by the receptionist can be opened — click anywhere on their row.
  2. 2Use Search or Date to find a specific patient, and Sort By to reorder the list.
  3. 3Click History on a row to see that patient's past visits before you see them.
A checked-in patient, ready to be seen
2

Record symptoms & vitals

Click the patient's row to open their consultation form.

  1. 1Under Subjective, tap the grey chips (e.g. Fever, Sore Throat) to add common complaints, or type your own in the box.
  2. 2Fill in History of Present Illness, Past Medical History and Allergies the same way.
  3. 3Under Objective, enter Vitals (BP, pulse, temperature, etc.) and tap chips for the examination findings.
Tap a chip to add it, tap again to remove it
3

Diagnose, prescribe & order labs

Scroll down within the same form — Assessment and Plan.

  1. 1Under Assessment, tap a diagnosis chip or type the Provisional Diagnosis. This field is required.
  2. 2Under Plan, type a drug name in Drug Name (matching suggestions appear), fill Dose/Route/Freq/Duration/Qty, then click Add Medication.
  3. 3To order a test, type its name under Investigations and click Add Test.
  4. 4Add any Advice and a Follow-up Date if needed.
One medication and one lab test added
💡Chief Complaints and Provisional Diagnosis are mandatory — you can't complete the consultation without them.
4

Save & complete the consultation

Two separate steps: save your notes, then finalize the visit.

  1. 1Click Save all Details, then confirm with Yes, Save Details. This just saves — you can still edit later.
  2. 2Back on the dashboard, click the yellow ✅ icon in the patient's row.
  3. 3Review the Patient Prescription Summary, including a preview of the printed OPD slip.
  4. 4Click Confirm & Complete. This is final — you can't edit after this.
Step 2 — the yellow icon appears once mandatory fields are filled
Step 3 — your last chance to check before finalizing
⚠Confirm & Complete cannot be undone. Use Cancel on that screen to go back and edit first if anything looks wrong.
5

Patient visit history

Patient Visit History in the left menu — every completed visit, yours and past.

  1. 1Toggle between Recent Visits (Past 7 Days) and Search Past Patients.
  2. 2Click View History on a row to see that patient's full past notes and prescriptions.
A completed visit, ready to review

Getting help

If a screen looks different from this guide, or an action doesn't behave as described, stop and contact your Admin or IT support before continuing. This guide was captured directly from the system on 8 September 2026 using a training patient record; nothing here is a real patient's data.
